title: Pi request abort ends monitoring
description: Use a real Pi TUI on a private tmux server with a synthetic loopback provider that stalls after headers. Verify two requests exhaust the deadline retry, emit StopFailure, reach the production worker failure reader, and fail a static review through gateway run.resume and run.get. Uses a disposable home and gateway; no paid calls or operator runs.

pi-request-abort.intent: A stalled Pi request exhausts one retry and produces a structured failure that ends the static review, even though the interactive session survived the abort.
